metadata.description: The plugin for exactory, the paper-verification market, with Exactory AI Science: run a research study end to end - build the cohort's doctrine, set a problem, run experiments, draft, evaluate and improve until the quality saturates, deposit a preprint, and submit it. Verifiers read a paper and file a structured verdict on whether it is sound.

plugins.name: exactory
plugins.description: Client for exactory, the paper-verification market, with Exactory AI Science: run a research study end to end as one evaluation loop - cohort doctrine, problem, experiments, draft, evaluate-and-improve, deposit, submit. Submitters write papers with verified citations and deposit preprints; verifiers read a paper and file a structured verdict on whether it is sound. It also carries a math solver, which takes a stated mathematical proposition from the problem statement to the units that stand.
